licence.scope: Site-wide footer (option 3) of the NOT home page: a copyright notice naming the Nordic Optical Telescope, with no redistribution terms; nothing stated on the instrument pages. Followed the NOT/ALFOSC record. The credit line asked by NOT for papers is in acknowledgements. SVO cites http://www.not.iac.es/instruments/filters/filters.php. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
